verdicts.reason: Both lose all the text: no headline, no URL, no 'HO SMART' wordmark, so the message and brand are gone. A floats an empty blue slab in the middle, shrinks the hand photo into a tiny strip next to a grey placeholder bar, and sets a huge white device icon on white so it barely shows. B at least keeps the blue band at the top and a bigger photo, but the stripes run awkwardly over the photo, the icon is also white on white, and the bottom 60% of the canvas is empty.
